integrity: The embedded finite certificate uses standard Python, exhaustive face enumeration, complete gradient acyclicity verification, relative unit-coefficient integer Morse cancellation and direct mod-two corroboration. Existing intact graph homotopy is credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification of the Fano incidence graph under single-edge deletion only; multi-edge deletions, general graphs, equivariant maps and canonical bases are not asserted.
title: A primitive nine-sphere cofiber for single-edge faults in the Heawood perfect-matching complex
